whatIsTiler.question: What is Tiler, and how does it work?
whatIsTiler.answer: Tiler is not a calendar, it is an AI-powered scheduling app that not only manages your tasks but also optimizes your time. It creates smart, flexible schedules using AutoTiles that adjust as your day shifts, while also letting you lock in non-negotiable tasks using Blocks.

differentFromCalendar.question: How is Tiler different from Google Calendar or other calendar apps?
differentFromCalendar.answer: Unlike static calendars, Tiler is your AI scheduling assistant. Just tell it what you need to do in plain English—it asks clarifying questions, calculates travel time between locations, and proposes a complete schedule. When life changes, Tiler adapts your timeline automatically. You confirm changes before they're made, so you stay in control.

aiAccuracy.question: Can I trust the AI to schedule my tasks correctly?
aiAccuracy.answer: Tiler uses a confirmation-first approach—it proposes schedules and waits for your approval before making changes. The AI learns your patterns over time and gets smarter about durations, locations, and preferences. You can always undo or adjust any suggestion.

locationPrivacy.question: Is my location data private? How does Tiler use it?
locationPrivacy.answer: Tiler respects your privacy. You can use generic labels like 'home,' 'work,' or 'local cafe' instead of specific addresses. Location data is only used to calculate realistic travel times between tasks, ensuring your schedule accounts for real-world constraints. Your data is never shared or sold.

calendarIntegration.question: Why do I need to integrate my calendar?
calendarIntegration.answer: Integrating your calendar with Tiler lets you see all your tasks, events, and schedules in one place. No more juggling multiple apps or risking double bookings—Tiler automatically syncs everything and optimizes your day for maximum productivity.

multipleCalendars.question: Can I integrate multiple calendars to my Tiler account?
multipleCalendars.answer: Yes! You can integrate multiple calendars into your Tiler account. This way, all your events and tasks are in one place.

tileVsBlock.question: What's the difference between a Tile and a Block?
tileVsBlock.answer: Tiles are flexible tasks that Tiler automatically schedules and adjusts based on your availability. Blocks are fixed tasks that stay exactly where you set them—perfect for meetings or tasks that can't be moved.

tileShare.question: How does TileShare work?
tileShare.answer: TileShare lets you share tasks with others—friends, family, teammates—so everyone knows what needs to be done and who's handling it. Assign tasks, track progress, and sync schedules effortlessly.

missedTask.question: What if I miss a task or need to reschedule?
missedTask.answer: No worries! Tiler's Defer feature automatically finds the next best time to complete a missed task. You can also manually reschedule with a simple drag-and-drop.

habitTracking.question: Can Tiler help with habit tracking?
habitTracking.answer: Yes! You can use Tiler to schedule and track daily habits. Tiler auto-fits them into your schedule, so you stay consistent.

transitFeature.question: How can I use the Transit feature?
transitFeature.answer: The transit feature goes beyond just calculating travel time — it acts as your navigation assistant. It helps you plan routes, suggests the best modes of transportation, and provides real-time directions for seamless transitions between tasks and locations. Just tap the travel icon to get instant navigation, ensuring you're always on time and on track.

setUpTiler.summary: Your calendar, your preferences, your constraints — four steps that give Tiler everything it needs to run Adaptive Scheduling from day one.

account.title: Create your account

setUpTiler.supportNote: Each step is an input to Tiler’s scheduling engine — your calendar tells it what’s fixed, your preferences tell it how you move, and your time limits tell it when you’re free. Together, they give Tiler the full picture it needs to run Adaptive Scheduling: a schedule that adjusts itself when things change.

whatIsTiler.title: Not a calendar. An AI that runs your day
whatIsTiler.summary: Tell Tiler what needs doing. It finds the time, handles conflicts, and adjusts when your day doesn’t go to plan.

aiRunsDay.title: Tiler is an AI that runs your day.
aiRunsDay.content: When a meeting runs long, or a task gets deferred, Tiler doesn’t wait for you to fix it. It detects the shift and rebuilds your schedule around it, instantly. You set the intent. Tiler handles the rest.

howToUseTiler.title: From intent to done. In seconds.
howToUseTiler.summary: Connect your calendar, add your tiles, and let Tiler build the rest. A step-by-step guide to running your day with Tiler.

connectCalendar.title: Connect a Calendar
connectCalendar.body: Connecting your calendar allows Tiler to see your real commitments. Once synced, incoming calendar events appear as blocks in your timeline. You can accept, edit, or resolve conflicts directly inside Tiler. When events change, Tiler adapts your tiles around them so your day stays balanced and realistic.

createBlock.title: How to Create a Block
createBlock.body: Blocks represent fixed commitments, meetings, appointments, events, and things that must happen at a specific time. When you create or sync a block, Tiler treats it as non-negotiable and schedules your flexible work around it. Blocks don’t move unless you move them. This is how Tiler respects real-world commitments while still keeping your day workable.

flexibleTiles.title: Creating Flexible Tiles
flexibleTiles.body: Tiles are where Tiler becomes powerful. A tile represents something you need to do, without locking it to a rigid time. You set the intent, estimated duration, and optional deadline — Tiler handles placement. Tiles can move, adapt, and reshuffle as your day changes, making them ideal for real work, errands, habits, and focus sessions.

updateTile.title: How to Update a Tile
updateTile.body: Updating a tile is how you communicate change to the system. You can adjust its duration, defer it, change its deadline, or mark it complete. The moment you do, Tiler re-optimises your timeline to reflect the update. You don’t need to move other tasks manually, the system handles the ripple effects.

travelTime.title: Travel Time & Route
travelTime.body: Add a location to any tile and Tiler handles the rest. It auto-detects where you need to be and calculates real travel time between every stop on your day. That orange block sitting between your tiles isn’t a gap — it’s your journey, already planned. Tap it and your route opens: turn-by-turn directions loaded, time accounted for. Your schedule doesn’t just tell you what to do. It gets you there.

features.title: Everything Tiler can do.
features.summary: Every feature is built around one principle: your schedule should work for you, not the other way around.

adaptiveTiles.name: Adaptive Tiles
adaptiveTiles.desc: The core unit of Tiler. Each tile is a task, event, or habit with a duration — Tiler schedules them intelligently and moves them when your day changes.

aiScheduling.name: AI scheduling assistant
aiScheduling.desc: Tiler asks clarifying questions, proposes the best available time, and builds a complete schedule including dependencies — always with your approval first.

chatScheduling.name: Chat scheduling
chatScheduling.desc: Tell Tiler what you need through a natural chat interface. It understands your intent and proposes a plan without you filling in a single form.

naturalLanguage.name: Natural language input
naturalLanguage.desc: Describe tasks in plain English — no forms, no dropdowns. Tiler understands context, urgency, duration, and location from how you naturally talk.

autoTravel.name: Auto travel buffers
autoTravel.desc: Tiler automatically inserts realistic travel time between location-based tiles based on your actual distance and transit options. Back-to-back never means late.

autoLocations.name: Auto locations
autoLocations.desc: Link locations to tiles once and Tiler remembers. Every time that task appears, travel time is calculated automatically from wherever you are.

timeRestrictions.name: Time restrictions
timeRestrictions.desc: Set the hours you’re available and Tiler only schedules within those bounds. Your personal time stays yours — no task bleeds into off-hours unless you allow it.

adaptiveRescheduling.name: Adaptive rescheduling
adaptiveRescheduling.desc: When a meeting runs long or a task gets missed, Tiler detects the ripple across your whole day and proposes fixes — instantly, with your approval before changing anything.

calendarIntegration.name: Calendar integration
calendarIntegration.desc: Connect Google Calendar or Outlook. Tiler reads your existing events and schedules all new tiles around them — no double bookings, ever. Supports multiple calendars.

crossPlatform.name: Cross-platform sync
crossPlatform.desc: Web, iOS, and Android all stay in real-time sync. Start a task on your laptop and check in on your phone without missing a beat. One schedule, everywhere.

habitScheduling.name: Habit scheduling
habitScheduling.desc: Add recurring habits and Tiler auto-fits them around your day — keeping you consistent with your routines without you having to think about it each morning.

deferReschedule.name: Defer & reschedule
deferReschedule.desc: Missed a tile? Tiler’s Defer feature instantly finds the next best slot and reschedules with one tap. Never lose a task — just push it forward intelligently.

smartNotifications.name: Smart notifications
smartNotifications.desc: Get alerted when it’s time to leave for your next tile — with live transit updates if your route changes. Never miss a departure time because you lost track of the clock.

tileShare.name: TileShare
tileShare.desc: Share tiles with family or teammates. Assign who handles what. Track completion. Everyone’s calendar adapts around shared commitments automatically — no extra apps needed.

seo.title: Get Started with Tiler | AI Scheduling & Smart Calendar App
seo.description: Tiler is the AI-powered calendar that automatically builds your perfect daily schedule. Set your schedule boundaries, pin your location, and let the AI solver build a timeline that actually fits your life.
seo.keywords: AI scheduling app, smart calendar, agentic calendar, AI task scheduler, adaptive scheduling, AI calendar app, intelligent time management, location-aware scheduling, AI productivity app, smart daily planner

hero.title: Vos cinq premières minutes avec Tiler
hero.subtitle: Tiler builds your perfect timeline from three things: your goals, your appointments, and your location. Here's how onboarding gets you there.

intro.lede: Most scheduling tools ask you to start from scratch … dragging blank boxes onto an empty grid and hoping the puzzle solves itself. Tiler works differently. Before you ever see a timeline, the app learns the shape of your day so it can build one that actually fits.
intro.body: Onboarding takes about five minutes. By the end, Tiler's engine has enough context to generate a constraint-aware, location-anchored schedule that adapts as your week shifts. Three pillars drive everything:

steps.heading: Six étapes vers votre première chronologie

step1.title: Connectez-vous et créez votre profil
step1.body: Everything starts with your Tiler account. Sign in and the app immediately begins building your profile memory! The contextual layer that the engine uses to understand how you work, when you're available, and what matters to you.

step2.title: Définissez votre heure de réveil
step2.body: The first question is deceptively simple: when does your day begin? This single data point establishes the earliest boundary the engine will schedule around. Night owl or early riser, Tiler starts from your reality, not an arbitrary 9 AM default.
step2.callout: Every constraint in Tiler flows from your boundaries. Wake time, work hours, and location form the hard edges that the solver respects before optimizing anything else.

step3.title: Indiquez votre emplacement
step3.body: Where are you most of the day? Tiler integrates with Google Maps so travel time between tasks is real, calculated by driving, transit, or walking, and not a vague guess. This is the piece most planning tools skip entirely, and it's why their schedules crumble when you actually try to live them. The autocomplete pulls from Google's Places API, so you can enter anything from a corporate headquarters to a co-working space to a job site.

step4.title: Définissez vos heures de travail
step4.body: Not every day looks the same. Tiler lets you set work hours per day of the week: toggle days on and off, shift start and end times, and copy a schedule across multiple days. This creates the temporal fence that separates work blocks from personal time. The engine treats these as soft constraints, strong enough to shape your default schedule, flexible enough to bend when a deadline or travel commitment demands it.

step5.title: Initialisez vos tuiles
step5.body: This is where Tiler begins to feel different. Based on your professional profile, the engine suggests recurring activity tiles (blocks of work) it thinks you'll need. Client calls. Deep work. Business development. Weekly reflection. You select the ones that match, delete the ones that don't, and set each to daily or weekly cadence.
step5.calloutStrong: Proposé par l'IA, sélectionné par l'humain.
step5.callout: The suggestions come from the LLM analyzing your professional context. You stay in control of what gets scheduled; the engine handles when and where.

step6.title: Votre chronologie, prête à l'emploi
step6.body: With your constraints loaded, the solver runs. What appears isn't a blank calendar waiting to be filled; it's an optimized timeline with your tiles placed where they fit, travel time accounted for, and work hours respected. Each tile is color-coded and linked to a location, with expandable action menus for quick edits. Add new tasks through natural language, run what-if scenarios to test alternatives, or share tiles with your team. The onboarding planted the seeds, and the engine grows the schedule from here.

seo.title: Get Started with Tiler | AI Scheduling & Smart Calendar App
seo.description: Tiler is the AI-powered calendar that automatically builds your perfect daily schedule. Set your schedule boundaries, pin your location, and let the AI solver build a timeline that actually fits your life.
seo.keywords: AI scheduling app, smart calendar, agentic calendar, AI task scheduler, adaptive scheduling, AI calendar app, intelligent time management, location-aware scheduling, AI productivity app, smart daily planner

intro.lede: Most scheduling tools ask you to start from scratch, dragging blank boxes onto an empty grid and hoping the puzzle solves itself. Tiler works differently. Before you ever see a timeline, the app learns the shape of your day so it can build one that actually fits.
intro.body: Onboarding takes about five minutes. By the end, Tiler's engine has enough context to generate a constraint-aware, location-anchored schedule that adapts as your week shifts. Three pillars drive everything:

naturalLanguageScheduling.title: Natural-Language Scheduling
naturalLanguageScheduling.subtitle: Just tell Tiler what you need to do, in plain English, and watch a smart schedule appear.
naturalLanguageScheduling.excerpt: Stop wrestling with drag-and-drop. Just tell Tiler what you need to do in plain English and watch a smart schedule appear.
naturalLanguageScheduling.author: Tiler Team

sections.text: Most scheduling tools treat you like a calendar operator. You drag, you drop, you resize, and then life changes and you start over. Tiler takes a different approach: you talk, it schedules.
Type something like "Dentist at 9 AM Thursday, then coffee with Priya downtown around 11" and Tiler handles the rest. Duration, travel time, buffer gaps, confirmation. All of it.

sections.stepBody: Type what you need to do in plain English. No special syntax, no dropdowns. "Gym session tomorrow morning for an hour" is enough to get started.

callout.label: What Tiler understands
callout.text: Relative time ("tomorrow"), duration ("an hour"), and location cues ("downtown"). No extra setup needed.

sections.stepTitle: The AI fills in the gaps
sections.stepBody: Tiler reasons about your request before responding. It infers duration from context, checks your existing commitments, and accounts for travel. If one detail is genuinely unclear, it asks one targeted question, never a form.

callout.label: Reasoning, not guessing
callout.text: Tiler cross-references your location, your existing tiles, and your preferred time windows before it proposes anything.

sections.stepBody: Tiler shows you the proposed schedule with full details: time, location, and travel. You confirm, adjust, or ask for alternatives. Nothing lands on your calendar without your say-so.

callout.label: Confirmation-first
callout.text: Tiler proposes. You decide. You stay in control even as the AI does the heavy lifting.

sections.quote: You live it. Tiler plans it.

smartTravelAndLocation.title: Smart Travel and Location
smartTravelAndLocation.subtitle: A schedule that ignores location isn't a schedule. It's a guess.
smartTravelAndLocation.excerpt: Tiler calculates travel time between every commitment and builds it into your day so your schedule reflects real life, not wishful thinking.
smartTravelAndLocation.author: Tiler Team

sections.text: Most calendars assume that once one task ends, you're ready for the next. But real life has a commute. Tiler builds that commute into your schedule, so every block in your timeline actually reflects where you need to be.
Add a meeting, an errand, a coffee catch-up, or a school pickup. Tiler automatically calculates how you'll get there and how long it takes, then slots travel time directly into your day.

sections.stepBody: You don't need to enter exact addresses every time. Set your home, work, and any regular spots once. From then on, Tiler knows where you're starting from and where you're headed.

callout.label: Location labels Tiler understands
callout.text: Home · Work · Downtown · The gym · Near the office

sections.stepTitle: Travel time slots into your timeline
sections.stepBody: Every time you add a task with a location, Tiler inserts a travel block between it and whatever comes before or after. It appears as its own segment in your timeline, so you always know when you need to leave.

callout.label: Real routes, not estimates
callout.text: Tiler uses live routing data covering driving, transit, and walking so travel time reflects how you actually get around.

sections.stepBody: When multiple tasks share the same area of town, Tiler groups them together so you're not zigzagging across the city. Errands near your gym land before or after your workout. A client visit near downtown gets paired with your lunch nearby.

callout.label: Less travel, more done
callout.text: Smart grouping means fewer trips, less wasted time in transit, and a day that flows the way it should.

sections.quote: Getting something done isn't just about finding the time. It's about being in the right place.

scheduleUndo.title: Schedule Undo
scheduleUndo.subtitle: Every schedule change shows you a live preview first. Undo it instantly or accept it with confidence. Your original plan is always one tap away.
scheduleUndo.excerpt: Preview any schedule change before it saves. Undo it instantly or accept it with confidence. Your live schedule is never touched without your approval.
scheduleUndo.author: Tiler Team

sections.text: Changing your schedule feels risky. Move one task and you're not sure what else shifts. Accept a suggestion and wonder if it was the right call. Schedule Undo gives you a safe zone between intention and commitment.
Every change in Tiler, whether you typed a request, accepted a suggestion, or moved a tile, first appears as a preview. Your live schedule stays untouched until you say so.

sections.stepBody: Move a tile, add a new task, or accept an AI suggestion. Instead of saving immediately, Tiler drops the change into preview. It shows with a dashed border and a PREVIEW label so you know it has not landed yet.

callout.label: Nothing saves automatically
callout.text: Your live schedule is frozen while you review. No partial saves, no accidental overwrites.

sections.stepBody: The preview tile shows the updated name, location, time, and date alongside what was there before. You see the full picture at a glance without having to mentally track what moved.
Not happy with the result? Tap Undo and your original schedule snaps back instantly. Happy with it? Tap Accept and it locks in. Either way, you made the call.

callout.label: Undo is always instant
callout.text: No undo history to scroll through. One tap and your exact original state is back, no matter how much shifted in the preview.

sections.text: Most calendar apps apply changes immediately and ask you to undo after the fact, by which point notifications have fired, sync has happened, and the damage is done. Schedule Undo flips this. The default is preview, not save.

sections.label: Built for tightly packed days
sections.text: When your day has no slack, a wrong move can ripple across everything. Schedule Undo gives you a moment to breathe and verify before any change goes live.
Whether you're rescheduling a workout, shifting a meeting, or taking on a task a colleague sent you, the preview step takes less than a second and can save you from a call you'd regret.

sections.quote: Change your mind before it counts.

tileshare.title: Tileshare
tileshare.subtitle: Send a task directly into someone else's schedule. It fits around their day automatically. No back-and-forth required.
tileshare.excerpt: Send adaptive tasks directly into someone else's Tiler. They land, they fit, they get done. No coordination overhead.
tileshare.author: Tiler Team

sections.text: Most task handoffs end up in a thread. You send it, they read it, they forget to schedule it, you follow up. Tileshare cuts out the middle. Share a tile and it lands in their Tiler, already scheduled.
When you share a tile, it arrives as a live adaptive task in the recipient's schedule. It finds the best open slot around their existing commitments. No placement required on either end.

sections.stepBody: From any task in your schedule, tap Share and select a Tiler contact. The tile is sent with everything the recipient needs to get it done.

callout.label: What travels with the tile
callout.text: Task name, estimated duration, deadline, and location tags. The recipient's personal schedule stays completely private.

sections.stepBody: The shared tile appears in the recipient's Tiler and finds the best open slot around their existing commitments. It adapts to their day, not the other way around.
Once the task is sent, you can see when it was scheduled, when it gets done, and if it gets moved. No follow-up messages. No status checks. You'll know.

callout.label: Shared accountability, zero friction
callout.text: Both sides see the same tile. One completes it. The other sees it done. Delegation that actually closes the loop.

sections.quote: Send it once. Know it gets done.
